name: cold14-st2s4
title: st2 with jp8 pivot swaps and four new entering dim-8 ends (s4), at dispatch jp8 x71, ck x1 with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP warm-started from st2's map)
summary: Provider menu {ck, jp8}: st2 words; jp8 adds pivot_swap (code/build_pivot_swap.py; PROOF-NOTE-PIVOT.md) and ends the new pivots at U24. Owner search (PivotSwap chain_st2s4.py -> rec3.py O2) with Stack492's solve_h.py (objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the st2s4 provider locals (PivotSwap locs2): (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3) warm-started from st2's map -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json; (2) dispatch: LP argmax (jp8 everywhere) with ck pinned at time 5 -> DISPATCH.json; (3) exact-window LP (crossover) over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json, bound 523257.373915; (4) exact-window MIP (no RINS) warm-started from st2's map (72 narrowing calls), gap 1e-9, 2 threads, 900 s: time limit, obj 523257.411446, bound 523257.373915, gap 7.17e-8; (5) mkplan.py --locals (st2s4 locals) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the dispatch jp8 ×71, ck ×1 (the aggregate free-dispatch LP selects jp8 at every time; ck is pinned at time 5 because the global controls need two dispatched providers)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (900 s time limit, relative gap 7.17e-8, no RINS), warm-started from complex-571-cold14-st2's map
owners.warm_owners_origin: complex-571-cold14-st2's `data/OWNERS.json.gz` (byte for byte), the warm start of the aggregate LP and the MIP

search.tool: solve_h.py (Stack492's copy: helper ranges from the word R)
search.dispatch_rule: per-time argmax of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections (jp8 everywhere), then ck pinned at time 5

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the st2s4 words {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), warm-started from st2's map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider}: jp8 everywhere except ck at time 5
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses (same as PR622's)

commands.chain: chain_st2s4.py: rec3.py O2 <locs2> <warm> 900, then mkplan.py O2-rins/PLAN.json O2-rins/OWNERS.json.gz O2-PLAN.json --locals locs2
